name: chrome-job-app-tracker
description: Click-to-capture companion for the Jobs repo: MV3 extension + local server

scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @jat/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/core typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/server typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/extension typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/native-host typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/cli typecheck
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --filter @jat/extension build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @jat/shared test && bun run --filter @jat/core test && bun run --filter @jat/server test && bun run --filter @jat/extension test && bun run --filter @jat/native-host test && bun run --filter @jat/cli test
